verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no testing utilities: no mock or fake model, no stubbed-tool harness, and no unit-test guidance for the Claude Agent SDK. Custom tools, hooks and the canUseTool callback are developer building blocks someone could use to build test doubles, not a documented mocking capability. The SDK also runs by spawning a bundled claude CLI subprocess, and nothing shows that the model can be swapped out for tests.

support.subject: As a developer, I can unit-test agents with mocked models and tools
